dogecoin.text:
@marcusacylar @elonmusk @mcuban I think #dogecoin represents the spirit of a large portion of Internet culture—complete irreverence for authority. In that there is power. And the community is the proof.

But I’m not sure about the potential as a reliable medium of exchange. Esp considering lack of scarcity.
I wanna see a #Dogecoin Twitter Space happen. Would love to hear @elonmusk & @mcuban talk about why it’s the “best” medium of exchange.
